knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The inspection works only when each item is checked and each deficiency is acted on. The other options describe a record that cannot show what was found.
The source explains that naming the person for each task lets management control the level of sanitation.
A deficiency is recorded, corrected and rechecked. Removing it from the checklist or leaving it unrecorded hides the problem.

practicalCriteria: Learner inspects a practice zone and marks every item yes or no (pass: all items marked, none left blank).
Learner records each deficiency with location, action, owner and due date (pass: every no has all four).
Learner rechecks one corrected item and closes it with the date (pass: closure recorded).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Re-inspection entry with the closure date
stopWorkCriteria: A zone has pest evidence and the responsible person has not been reached.
A deficiency cannot be corrected safely by the inspector.
The checklist for the area is missing or out of date.
A worker is asked to sign a record for an inspection they did not carry out.
